scope: All constant-history cases; latest selected accession only. Original filing captures, not an assertion covering every historical filing or approval for publication. Comparison extraction excludes dimensional and nil facts, applies inline scale/sign, and recognizes only listed decimal/zero formats. Missing matches remain unresolved, not errors inferred in the issuer data.
decision_boundary: Completed primary capture for all33 constant-history cases. Successful inline comparisons establish selected numerical matches only, not universal measure scope. Failed inline comparisons may reflect older non-inline filings or unsupported formats; separate XBRL inspection is pending. Do not infer issuer error or approval from an unmatched extraction.
